g.text: Three separate test years do not establish a 21-year track record
0.6 bp per traded dollar; primary uses train-frozen scaling and stops. Benchmark is long-only, unscaled, daily rebalanced.
Current membership and current-vintage prices bias both series; risk exposures differ. Each panel restarts at $1.
